{{Quote|I doubt few would wish to engage you or your precious cargo in a battle wagon such as this.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]] on the ''Storm Killer''|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
'''''Storm Killer''''' was a heavily modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] which was optimized for combat and put on sale by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] used space [[Transport/Legends|transport]] salesman [[Fiz Cor'gril]].<ref name="AJ9" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|If it is weaponry that you seek, please step this way.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]] on the ''Storm Killer''|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
The ''Storm Killer'' was modified for maximum combat performance, with no regard to the consequences to other systems. The ventral turret housed an [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] [[Tomral Heavy Laser Cannon]], with increased power output. The dorsal gun had been replaced with an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[W-34t turbolaser]] turret,<ref name="AJ9" /> which was far too powerful for the ship's systems to be fired continuously. Additionally, the ship was equipped with an Arakyd [[Hi-fex proton torpedo launcher]] and two [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] [[Kd-3 light blaster cannon]]s. The latter ones were meant for ground use only.<ref name="AJ9" />

To optimize combat performance, the ''Storm Killer''{{'s}} shields and lateral thrusters were improved. The most drastic change was perhaps the rearrangement of the cockpit, moving it from the side to the middle, between the two mandibles,<ref name="AJ9" /> similar to a [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

All these modifications came at a cost: The weapon systems draw so much energy from the [[Power core/Legends|power core]] that space performance was reduced by around forty percent. A slight mishap with a weapon system could cause the entire weapon to break down. The added machinery and [[Capacitor/Legends|capacitors]] took up space usually reserved for passengers, consumables and cargo, making the ship only practical for small and extremely valuable cargos.<ref name="AJ9" />

==History==
{{Quote|You are not likely to find such a weapon on a starship of this class due to Imperial restrictions.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]] on the ''Storm Killer''|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
The ''Storm Killer'' was originally owned by a person who was obsessed with weaponry. Over the time, he added more and more firepower to the ship, paying no attention to the consequences. The [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] alone was far too powerful and illegal for such a ship by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] restrictions.<ref name="AJ9" />

Eventually, the ship ended up in the hands of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] starship salesman Fiz Cor'gril. He offered the ship for sale for 95,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and also offered [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] for those interested.<ref name="AJ9" />
